mapper.sql: i.id, o.id AS outbox_id, i.root_run_id, i.parent_run_id, i.child_run_id, i.parent_wait_group_id, i.parent_member_identity, i.parent_node_id, i.tool_call_id, i.plan_generation, i.node_attempt, i.operation_id, i.goal, i.context_text, i.child_model_name, i.child_endpoint_name, i.child_max_steps, i.parent_scheduler_version, i.parent_deployment_id, i.parent_deployment_generation_id, i.parent_config_snapshot_digest, i.parent_control_version, i.state, o.claim_token, o.state AS outbox_state, i.accepted_at, i.child_terminal_at, i.physical_stopped_at, i.capacity_released_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, plan_generation, run_control_version, scheduler_version, deployment_id, deployment_generation_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{intentId}
SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id WHERE o.id = #{outboxId}

SELECT , child.status AS child_run_status FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run child ON child.id = i.child_run_id WHERE i.child_run_id = #{childRunId}
SELECT FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id WHERE i.id = #{intentId} FOR UPDATE OF i, o

SELECT count(*) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_group g ON g.id = i.parent_wait_group_id AND g.run_id = i.parent_run_id JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.member_identity = i.parent_member_identity WHERE i.id = #{intentId} AND g.state = 'WAITING' AND m.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_tree_capacity(root_run_id) VALUES (#{rootRunId}) ON CONFLICT (root_run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_tree_capacity SET active_child_count = active_child_count - 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId} AND active_child_count > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM alphafrog_agent_run_tree_capacity WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId} AND active_child_count = 0
mapper.select: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent ( root_run_id, parent_run_id, child_run_id, parent_wait_group_id, parent_member_identity, parent_node_id, tool_call_id, plan_generation, node_attempt, operation_id, goal, context_text, child_model_name, child_endpoint_name, child_max_steps, parent_scheduler_version, parent_deployment_id, parent_deployment_generation_id, parent_config_snapshot_digest, parent_control_version) VALUES (#{request.rootRunId}, #{request.parentRunId}, #{childRunId}, #{request.parentWaitGroupId}, #{request.parentMemberIdentity}, #{request.parentNodeId}, #{request.toolCallId}, #{request.planGeneration}, #{request.nodeAttempt}, #{operationId}, #{request.goal}, #{request.context}, #{request.childModelName}, #{request.childEndpointName}, #{request.childMaxSteps}, #{parent.schedulerVersion}, #{parent.deploymentId}, #{parent.deploymentGenerationId}, #{request.parentConfigSnapshotDigest}, #{request.parentControlVersion}) RETURNING id

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o SET state = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = #{claimToken}, claimed_by = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, delivery_attempts = delivery_attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE o.id = ( SELECT q.id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox q JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i ON i.id = q.intent_id WHERE ((q.state = 'PENDING' AND q.next_delivery_at <= #{now}) OR (q.state = 'CLAIMED' AND q.lease_until <= #{now})) AND i.state = 'PENDING' ORDER BY q.next_delivery_at, q.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING o.id
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent SET state = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{intentId} AND state = 'PENDING'

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox SET state = 'ACKED', claim_token = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_until = NULL, acked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{outboxId} AND state = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent SET state = 'CANCELED_BEFORE_ACCEPT', cancel_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, child_terminal_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, physical_stopped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, capacity_released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{intentId} AND state = 'PENDING' AND capacity_released_at IS NULL

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox SET state = 'CANCELED', claim_token = NULL, claimed_by = NULL, lease_until = NULL, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE intent_id = #{intentId} AND state IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED')
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent SET state = 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', cancel_requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{intentId} AND state = 'ACCEPTED'

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i SET state = 'TERMINAL', child_terminal_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run child WHERE i.id = #{intentId} AND child.id = i.child_run_id AND child.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED') AND i.state IN ('ACCEPTED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND i.child_terminal_at IS NULL

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i SET physical_stopped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM alphafrog_agent_run child WHERE i.id = #{intentId} AND child.id = i.child_run_id AND i.state IN ('ACCEPTED', 'TERMINAL') AND i.physical_stopped_at IS NULL AND child.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED') AND COALESCE(child.tool_job_anchor_json, '{}'::jsonb) = '{}'::jsonb AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member m WHERE m.run_id = child.id AND (m.state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED') OR (m.external_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE( child.snapshot_json #> '{data_analysis_observability,calls}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS terminal(call) WHERE NULLIF(m.dispatch_proof_json ->> 'taskId', '') IS NOT NULL AND m.dispatch_proof_json ->> 'operationId' = m.external_operation_id AND m.result_ref_json ->> 'taskId' = m.dispatch_proof_json ->> 'taskId' AND terminal.call ->> 'operationId' = m.external_operation_id AND terminal.call ->> 'taskId' = m.dispatch_proof_json ->> 'taskId' AND terminal.call #>> '{reservation,state}' = 'TERMINAL_CONFIRMED' AND NULLIF(terminal.call ->> 'terminalStatus', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(terminal.call ->> 'terminalAt', '') IS NOT NULL))) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_work_item wi WHERE wi.run_id = child.id AND wi.state NOT IN ('RESULT_COMMITTED', 'EXECUTION_FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'STALE')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent descendant WHERE descendant.parent_run_id = child.id AND descendant.capacity_released_at IS NULL)

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent SET capacity_released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{intentId} AND capacity_released_at IS NULL AND child_terminal_at IS NOT NULL AND physical_stopped_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i WHERE i.child_run_id = r.id) THEN (SELECT i.root_run_id FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i WHERE i.child_run_id = r.id AND i.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) ELSE r.id END FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{rootRunId}) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent WHERE root_run_id = #{rootRunId} AND capacity_released_at IS NULL) ELSE NULL END

SELECT , child.status AS child_run_status FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run child ON child.id = i.child_run_id WHERE i.id > #{afterIntentId} AND i.state = 'ACCEPTED' AND (child.id IS NULL OR child.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED')) ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , child.status AS child_run_status, member.state AS parent_member_state FROM alphafrog_agent_run_child_intent i JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_child_outbox o ON o.intent_id = i.id JOIN alphafrog_agent_run_wait_member member ON member.group_id = i.parent_wait_group_id AND member.member_identity = i.parent_member_identity LEFT JOIN alphafrog_agent_run child ON child.id = i.child_run_id WHERE i.id > #{afterIntentId} AND i.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND member.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY i.id LIMIT #{limit}
